title: Chemists
description: Conduct qualitative and quantitative chemical analyses or experiments in laboratories for quality or process control or to develop new products or knowledge.

tasks.text: Develop, improve, or customize products, equipment, formulas, processes, or analytical methods.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids product development; prototyping and testing human

dwas.name: Develop new or advanced products or production methods.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Analyze organic or inorganic compounds to determine chemical or physical properties, composition, structure, relationships, or reactions, using chromatography, spectroscopy, or spectrophotometry techniques.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical analysis requires instruments and hands

tasks.text: Induce changes in composition of substances by introducing heat, light, energy, or chemical catalysts for quantitative or qualitative analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical analysis requires instruments and hands
visual inspection — Quality testing of materials is hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Test quality of materials or finished products.

tasks.text: Write technical papers or reports or prepare standards and specifications for processes, facilities, products, or tests.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Reports drafted; presentations need human delivery

dwas.name: Establish standards for products, processes, or procedures.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

dwas.name: Prepare scientific or technical reports or presentations.

tasks.text: Maintain laboratory instruments to ensure proper working order and troubleshoot malfunctions when needed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on lab/technical equipment upkeep

tasks.text: Prepare test solutions, compounds, or reagents for laboratory personnel to conduct tests.

dwas.name: Prepare compounds or solutions for products or testing.

tasks.text: Compile and analyze test information to determine process or equipment operating efficiency or to diagnose malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Operational/research data analysis; human interprets

dwas.name: Analyze test or performance data to assess equipment operation.

tasks.text: Confer with scientists or engineers to conduct analyses of research projects, interpret test results, or develop nonstandard tests.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Research collaboration is iterative human teamwork

dwas.name: Collaborate on research activities with scientists or technical specialists.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Evaluate laboratory safety procedures to ensure compliance with standards or to make improvements as needed.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Conformance checking aided by AI, but on-site verification is human

dwas.name: Monitor operational procedures in technical environments to ensure conformance to standards.

tasks.text: Direct, coordinate, or advise personnel in test procedures for analyzing components or physical properties of materials.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical supervision requires judgment and accountability

tasks.text: Purchase laboratory supplies, such as chemicals, when supplies are low or near their expiration date.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Resource management aided by AI but human accountable

dwas.name: Manage scientific or technical project resources.
